title: Consulting Engineer (Data Centre)
teaser: We are seeking a Consulting Engineer to design and implement advanced Data Centre and networking solutions, directly impacting customer success. You will leverage Cisco technologies and technical expertise to deliver robust services. Ideal candidates bring significant experience in customer-facing technical consulting and deep knowledge of networking protocols.
description:
Meet the Team 

The Customer Experience (CX) team is a group of extraordinary technical professionals dedicated to delivering a best-in-class customer experience. We tackle the toughest business challenges with network-centric solutions that accelerate customer success and loyalty. As the face of Cisco, our CX teams are the primary drivers of digital transformation. We accelerate customer and partner success through ground breaking design, implementation, and optimization across a broad range of Cisco technologies. Our team collaborates closely with Cisco account teams, partners, and multi-functional groups to drive meaningful technology transitions and deliver real business outcomes. We are a high-performing, globally connected team with a strong culture of continuous learning, mentorship, and knowledge sharing. Our success is reflected in our outstanding financial results, industry recognition, and high employee satisfaction.

Your Impact 

As a Consulting Engineer, you will build strong trust-based customer relationships, applying technical expertise to design, and implementation of sophisticated Data Centre and networking solutions that directly accelerate business outcomes. You will: 

Contribute to the design and implementation of cutting-edge Cisco Data Centre technologies for large and complex customer network environments.

Leverage innovative technology to solve real-world business problems and deliver scalable, robust services.

Integrate emerging AI and automation methods into delivery practices to automate manual deployment processes, and support infrastructure-as-code platforms

Analyze and monitor network performance providing impactful options for optimization, efficiency and capability improvements.

Support the team for complex problem resolution, demonstrating deep technical expertise to resolve sophisticated issues across a broad range of data centre technologies.

Develop and contribute digital intellectual capital, repeatable delivery frameworks, and knowledge-sharing practices..

Provide critical feedback to Engineering and Product organizations to influence future product roadmaps.

Minimum Qualifications

Bachelor's degree in Computer Science, or equivalent, with 7+ years of relevant experience in customer-facing technical consulting, pre-sales, and/or service delivery roles.

Deep knowledge of L2/L3 networking protocols and technologies (vPC, STP, HSRP, OSPF, EIGRP, BGP) with strong hands-on Nexus 2K/5K/7K/9K platform experience.

Proven experience in design and deployment of Data Centre solutions including traditional DC standalone Nexus design, Cisco VXLAN Fabric and Cisco ACI Fabric solutions using ACI MultiPod /Multisite/Remote Leaf Fabric architectures.

Experience integrating network services appliances (such as firewalls, IPS, load balancers, WAN optimizers) within Data Centre solution designs.

Professional level (e.g. CCNP, Cisco DevNet) or equivalent vendor certification (e.g. VCP) expected.

Preferred Qualifications 

Strong communication and planning skills, while being self-motivated with a focus on execution.

Knowledge of software programmability, automation (Python, Ansible, Terraform and so on), orchestration, and/or virtualization technologies.

Experience with compute, virtualization, and container environments including Cisco UCS, HyperFlex, VMware, Microsoft, and Kubernetes.

Technical familiarity with multi-cloud environments across AWS, Azure, and Google Cloud from a network integration perspective.

A current active UK Government Security Clearance, or willingness to be put forward for one, would be advantageous.

Why Cisco? 

At Cisco, we’re revolutionizing how data and infrastructure connect and protect organizations in the AI era – and beyond. We’ve been innovating fearlessly for 40 years to create solutions that power how humans and technology work together across the physical and digital worlds. These solutions provide customers with unparalleled security, visibility, and insights across the entire digital footprint.

Fueled by the depth and breadth of our technology, we experiment and create meaningful solutions. Add to that our worldwide network of doers and experts, and you’ll see that the opportunities to grow and build are limitless. We work as a team, collaborating with empathy to make really big things happen on a global scale. Because our solutions are everywhere, our impact is everywhere. 

We are Cisco, and our power starts with you.
